about_the_game:
Embark on an adventure to awaken the Ancient Evil and defeat it before it gains strength. Decide what will stand in your way on the looped road. The stronger the enemies, the greater the reward, but the risk is high! You only have one chance – if you lose in battle, the game ends.

Assemble a Mighty Army!

The kingdom will supply warriors, and your task is to manage them wisely. In autobattler-style fights, you must decide who will fight and how to avoid unnecessary losses. With each round, the enemies grow stronger!

Build a Kingdom!

Fill the lifeless wasteland with forests and buildings to gather strength for the battle against the Ancient Kings. Use and combine various tiles. Your ability to manage the land will determine everything!

Find Powerful Artifacts and Items!

For defeating enemies, you will receive items that will help strengthen your army. In special cases, you can obtain artifacts – powerful relics that will turn the tide of the game and open paths to completely new playstyles!

Choose Your Hero!

Each hero has their own story and unique features, as well as special units and artifacts that create random gameplay situations.

Defeat the Evil!

Each villain complicates your life in their own way. They send their minions with curses and debuffs. After completing the ritual and awakening one of the Ancient Kings, you must defeat their army! If you lose, the game starts over.

short_description: Kingdom Loop is a strategic roguelike autobattler focused on building your army and kingdom. Explore many tile combinations, items, and units in search of the perfect setup to beat the Ancient Kings!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Russian, Japanese
